name: Chicken enchiladas
steps: Shred the cooked chicken and mix with half the cheese and a spoon of the tinned tomatoes.
Soften the onion in a pan with the olive oil, then stir in the rest of the tomatoes with a pinch of salt.
Warm the corn tortillas so they roll without cracking.
Fill each tortilla with the chicken mix, roll, and lay seam-down in a small baking dish.
Pour the tomato sauce over the top and scatter the remaining cheese.
Bake at 200C for about 18 minutes until bubbling and golden.
